packageRules.description: One PR per window, one deploy: every merge to main is a production deploy (Workers Builds), and rapid merges coalesce builds — so a Monday's action-digest drift lands as a single grouped PR, opened for review (never automerged by Renovate; renovate.json holds no automerge). New majors wait for approval on the dependency dashboard.

dtolnay/rust-toolchain is pinned to a branch tip (stable), not a semver tag — Renovate can only offer digest updates for it, which would bypass the major gate below. Every refresh of an arbitrary branch tip is an operator decision.
Same-major action digest refreshes ride the grouped PR; a new major waits for approval on the dependency dashboard.

One PR per window for the workspace dependencies too: the whole npm drift lands as a single grouped PR on the shared Monday schedule, opened for review (this config automerges nothing). The global minimumReleaseAge mirrors bunfig.toml's 259200s supply-chain brake, so nothing freshly published rides in. Labelled npm because the top-level pair names the actions PRs; the rules below carve out the packages that must not move.

Same-major npm bumps ride the grouped PR; a new major waits for approval on the dependency dashboard, so a breaking bump is never carried in silently by a Monday group. The holds below override this with an outright block.
HELD: eslint majors in apps/mobile — eslint-config-expo's plugin chain crashes under ESLint 10; rides the Expo SDK arc.
HELD: tailwindcss stays v3 in apps/mobile — NativeWind 4.x is built for Tailwind 3; its loose peer range lies. Never bump until NativeWind ships Tailwind 4 support.
HELD: Expo-pinned native deps route through the Expo SDK bump only (bundledNativeModules.json is the authority, not the packages' own peer ranges).
HELD: @resvg/resvg-wasm pinned ~2.4.0 to match the copy workers-og bundles — a newer copy adds ~1 MB of Worker wasm for zero gain.
HELD: drizzle-orm 1.0 RC is peer-blocked by better-auth (^0.45.2); take it when better-auth follows.

GUARD: @remotion/bundler is patched via patchedDependencies, keyed by EXACT version — any bump must re-key patches/@remotion%2Fbundler@*.patch in the same PR (scripts/patched-dependencies.test.ts turns a detached patch into a red deploy gate). Surface it on the dashboard instead of auto-PRing.
